title: Objective 3 - verify button is hidden in portrait orientation
body:
Hi, when trying to complete objective 3 question, verify button is hidden in portrait orientation. In landscape it's present (took a bit of time to figure out what to do :)
Presumably translation is too long and button doesn't fit the screen anymore?

Samsung Galaxy A34, Android 14.
App version 3.3.2.0 (ba55)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b934fa93-2a6c-4e1d-8d24-40836361e354)
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9f54e163-cded-4ef8-bfe9-307f2179686a)

comments.body: I believe this is related to your accessibility setting. reset it to default

Setting smaller font in Accessibility settings made it visible, thanks.
Still, I would say it should probably float to the line below if there is no space? 
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/46f64657-d18e-4b37-bcd1-0b10fe6fc734)

It can be a combination of accessibility setting and translations.
You can change the translation in crowdin
